_comment: Config changes applied on top of the original pack's config files when the pack is built (build_pack.py). TOML entries replace 'key = value' lines in place (first match, any indentation); JSON entries set nested keys.

patches.why: Goblins about 10x rarer: spawn chance 25% -> 5% per attempt, attempts every 24000 ticks instead of 12000
Loot Integrations injects modded items into vanilla/structure chests with 3x extra weight; 1 = weighted like vanilla items (about 3x rarer than before)
Artifacts (Curios trinkets) 2x rarer in chests, archaeology and on mobs
Simply Swords loot weapons 2x rarer, pity thresholds doubled to match
